id: \rI wish I had more money. They don't sell this forever.
en: \rI wish I had more money. They don't sell this forever.
it: \rVorrei avere più soldi. Non lo venderanno per sempre.

id: \rThat shop looks shady to me.\nWhat do you think?
en: \rThat shop looks shady to me.\nWhat do you think?
it: \rQuel negozio mi sembra losco.\nTu che ne pensi?

id: \bJames: Welcome to our shop.
en: \bJames: Welcome to our shop.
it: \bJames: Benvenuti nel nostro negozio.

id: \rMisty: Hi \PN. Are you already done here?
en: \rMisty: Hi \PN. Are you already done here?
it: \rMisty: Ciao \PN. Hai già finito qui?

id: \rI would have got here sooner, but I wanted to wait until I took over as the Cerulean Gym Leader.
en: \rI would have got here sooner, but I wanted to wait until I took over as the Cerulean Gym Leader.
it: \rSarei arrivata prima, ma volevo aspettare di diventare Capopalestra di Celestopoli.

id: \rThat's right, you're fighting with a Gym Leader now.
en: \rThat's right, you're fighting with a Gym Leader now.
it: \rEsatto, ora stai parlando con una Capopalestra.

id: \rMisty: What are you going to do now? Why don't you talk to Professor Oak? He might be able to help.
en: \rMisty: What are you going to do now? Why don't you talk to Professor Oak? He might be able to help.
it: \rMisty: Cosa farai adesso? Perché non parli con il Professor Oak? Forse può aiutarti.

id: \rMisty: I've decided to become a permanent Gym Leader. Isn't that exciting?
en: \rMisty: I've decided to become a permanent Gym Leader. Isn't that exciting?
it: \rMisty: Ho deciso di diventare Capopalestra a tempo pieno. Non è emozionante?

id: \bThe Silver Conference is so much fun.
en: \bThe Silver Conference is so much fun.
it: \bLa Conferenza Argento è davvero divertente.

id: \rJessie: How can we help you?
en: \rJessie: How can we help you?
it: \rJessie: Come possiamo aiutarti?

id: \bBrock: Hey \PN! I figured you would be here.
en: \bBrock: Hey \PN! I figured you would be here.
it: \bBrock: Ehi, \PN! Immaginavo che saresti stato qui.

id: \bI'm here to see if I can find any strong women. Do you know any you could introduce me to?
en: \bI'm here to see if I can find any strong women.  Do you know any you could introduce me to?
it: \bSono qui per vedere se trovo qualche ragazza forte.  Ne conosci qualcuna da presentarmi?

id: \bI'll make it worth your time. Let's get in some quick training.
en: \bI'll make it worth your time. Let's get in some quick training.
it: \bNe varrà la pena. Facciamo un rapido allenamento.

id: \bBrock: Great battle \PN! If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
en: \bBrock: Great battle \PN! If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
it: \bBrock: Gran bella lotta, \PN! Se vuoi, posso curare l'aspetto di uno dei tuoi Pokémon. Potrebbe aiutarlo in lotta.

id: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
en: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
it: \bBrock: A quale Pokémon vuoi che faccia la toelettatura?

id: \bBrock: Oh, okay then.
en: \bBrock: Oh, okay then.
it: \bBrock: Oh, va bene allora.

id: \bBrock: There! \v[2] looks a lot better now!
en: \bBrock: There!  \v[2] looks a lot better now!
it: \bBrock: Ecco fatto!  \v[2] ha un aspetto molto migliore ora!

id: \bWobbuffet!
en: \bWobbuffet!
it: \bWobbuffet!

id: \bI need a last minute capture to finish my team.
en: \bI need a last minute capture to finish my team.
it: \bMi serve una cattura dell'ultimo minuto per completare la squadra.

id: \bI didn't get all the badges, so I wish you luck.
en: \bI didn't get all the badges, so I wish you luck.
it: \bNon ho ottenuto tutte le medaglie, quindi ti auguro buona fortuna.

id: Yes
en: Yes
it: Sì

id: No
en: No
it: No
